supersedes.reason: Earlier frontend checkpoint precedes the final learning request-cancellation fix.

protocol.sourceMaterialization: Fresh git archive of Front into four separate owned directories
protocol.dependencies: Same existing lockfile-validated dependency tree, read through a symlink; no dependency install or update
protocol.envFiles: Committed .env.example only; no active Vite .env files allowed
protocol.initialDefinition: The single module script referenced by generated index.html, not the complete initial request graph
protocol.totalDefinition: Sum of every emitted .js file, including lazy pages, optional monitoring SDK and public theme-init.js
protocol.compression: Each file independently compressed with Node gzip level 9 / Brotli quality 11; totals sum individual files

limitations: Static build artifact sizes, not transfer bytes observed through nginx or a CDN.
Total emitted JavaScript is not downloaded for every route; optional monitoring remains a separate chunk.
Initial module entry excludes its dependency graph, theme-init.js, CSS, fonts and HTML.
No browser parse/execute/render timing, LCP/INP/CLS, CPU/RSS or real-device performance inference.
One fresh build per condition; no claim of repeated-build determinism or performance significance.
